chat_messages.content: If Eliud Kipchoge could maintain his record-making marathon pace indefinitely, how many thousand hours would it take him to run the distance between the Earth and the Moon its closest approach? Please use the minimum perigee value on the Wikipedia page for the Moon when carrying out your calculation. Round your result to the nearest 1000 hours and do not use any comma separators if necessary.

Searching Wikipedia for the Moon page to find its minimum perigee value, and for Eliud Kipchoge's marathon world record.
```python
moon_info = await wikipedia_search(query="Moon")
kipchoge_info = await wikipedia_search(query="Eliud Kipchoge")
print(f"Moon search: {moon_info}\nKipchoge search: {kipchoge_info}")
```

```python
moon_html = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon")
kipchoge_html = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eliud_Kipchoge")
print(f"Moon text len: {len(moon_html)}, Kipchoge text len: {len(kipchoge_html)}")
```
